title: Adaptive Microjourney Ribbon: condensed hero, step ribbon, and progressive modules for Quickstart landing
creator: Ari Sharma
description: Redesign Quickstart landing hero and adjacent step modules to support progressive disclosure, mobile-first layout, and persona-specific entry points. Deliver a compressed hero with an interactive 'microjourney ribbon' that surfaces the three most common starter flows, integrated screenshot anchors for each step, and a single-fileable SVG illustration system to reduce bundle size. The design should be implementable by the front-end team with minimal layout overrides, include an accessibility-first approach (keyboard focus states, screen reader flow), and a documented asset pipeline for responsive screenshots and Lottie micro-animations.
acceptance_criteria: Hero collapsed height <= 420px on desktop 1280px width; hero content stacks at <= 720px and uses ribbon in place of full diagram
Microjourney ribbon exposes first 3 steps for each persona and expands to full step rail on click/keyboard action
SVG illustration assets provided as a single sprite with clear tokenized color vars and accessible title/desc tags
Figma spec includes concrete CSS tokens, responsive breakpoint guidance, and copy variations for Developer/PM/Platform personas
Engineering-ready screenshot pipeline doc with sample script, and 4 artifact sizes (xs/s/m/l)
Design QA checklist completed and signed off by Eng lead and PM

decisions: Favor an adaptive ribbon pattern (compact by default, expands on interaction) instead of a full horizontal step rail to save vertical space and mobile real estate.
Implement illustrations as an SVG sprite with CSS tokenized colors to support runtime theme overrides and reduce network requests.
Use small Lottie spritelites for micro-interactions (hover/expand) only on desktop; fallback to CSS transitions on low-power devices.
Automate screenshot generation via a headless Chrome script stored in the design assets folder; images will be versioned and referenced from the docs release pipeline.
